source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of data provenance (PDF 185).

blocks.text: Data provenance (data ka pichhla record) ka matlab hai data ki history (tareekh): yeh kahan se aaya aur is mein kaise tabdeeli (modify) ki gayi.

Misal: Agar koi study (research) kisi scientific journal (science ka research magazine) mein chhapi ho, to yeh jaanna zaroori hai ke us study mein kaunse methods (tareeqe) aur data ke sources istemal hue.

blocks.prompt: MCQ 6: Data provenance ka kya matlab hai?
blocks.explanation: (b) Data ki history aur origin (yeh kahan se aaya). (Kitab ki answer key yahan (c) “source ki popularity (mashhoori)” deti hai, jo text ke khilaf hai.)

items: Data provenance: data kahan se aaya aur kaise badla; study ke methods aur data sources jaanein.
